verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is accounting SaaS, where a built-in AI assistant is a reasonable capability to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only automation features: Smart Capture data extraction and smart categorisation of transactions. Neither is an in-product assistant a user can hand tasks to, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
